TC_003 Description quotes "Verify an AR PASSE inbound 834 enrollment file containing the Maintenance Date in Loop 2000 DTP*303 is processed end to end, the first Maintenance Date occurrence is retained when multiple Maintenance Date occurrences are present" and TC_005 Description quotes "Verify inbound AR PASSE 834 processing identifies multiple Maintenance Date occurrences in Loop 2000 DTP*303, uses the first occurrence only for transaction effective date population"; shared intent is first Maintenance Date occurrence selection

TC_004 Description quotes "Verify inbound AR PASSE 834 processing identifies multiple Eligibility Date occurrences in Loop 2000 DTP*356 or DTP*348, uses the first occurrence only for transaction effective date population" and TC_001 Description quotes "Verify an AR PASSE inbound 834 enrollment file containing the Eligibility Date in Loop 2000 DTP*356 and Loop 2000 DTP*348 is processed end to end, the first Eligibility Date occurrence is retained when multiple Eligibility Date occurrences are present"; shared intent is first Eligibility Date occurrence selection
